rules: The original T02 context is invalidated before SERVICES_RESUMED, unchanged.
A distinct guarded pre-C opaque export capsule is terminal-only, never read by simulation and never used to resume measured work.
Trace is non-authoritative append-only diagnostic output during acquisition, immutable after freeze.
Export is admitted only after acquisition stops, DMA drains, display/audio/IRQ stop, ROM and capsule verify, and NMI is absent.
Consume the export capability before calling storage; no automatic retry or transition back to acquisition.
Terminal staging overlays dead ordinary resident code/data only after irreversible entry; all terminal code/data must remain below STAGING_START.
Save chunks with unique G1T00 through G1T19 names without replace syntax; no pre-existing file may be overwritten.
The acquisition record and export outcome are separate; transport success is not timing or workload acceptance.
Physical export evidence requires extraction of actual saved bytes and independent length, ordering, CRC and semantic validation.
